review_evidence: Codex self-review: chapter theme, pedagogy stages, deterministic keys, unseen passages, assessment coverage, age fit, and source independence
title: Night
source_note: NCERT structural alignment only. Zidd uses original teaching passages, checks, and assessment scenes instead of copying textbook prose.

levels.title: From bright day to quiet night
levels.focus: identify a poem scene and main idea
levels.teaching_goal: Use linked details about fading light, evening sounds, and rest to explain the poem's night scene.

guided_check.teaching_block: A poem's main idea grows from details that belong together. A sinking sun, lit lamps, quiet birds, and sleepy homes all show day changing into night.
guided_check.passage: The orange sun slips behind the hill. Shop lights blink on, and sparrows settle under the roof.
options: a storm is flooding the road

bridge.teaching_block: Group the clues: less sunlight + lamps glowing + birds resting. Together they name evening.
bridge.passage: The lane grows dim. A lamp shines beside the gate.

masterclass.teaching_block: Do not select one object as the main idea. 'There is a lamp' is a detail; the stronger answer explains the whole change.
masterclass.passage: The sun is hidden, windows glow, and families speak softly indoors.
masterclass.prompt: Which answer covers the entire scene?

independent_check.teaching_block: Read a fresh scene and explain its main idea.
independent_check.passage: The playground empties. Bats sweep above the trees, and the watchman switches on the gate light.
independent_check.prompt: What main idea connects the scene?

concept_slots.description: Name evening or night.
Mention the place becoming quiet or empty.
Use one night clue.

transfer_check.teaching_block: Recognize the same day-to-night change in a harbour.
transfer_check.passage: Fishing boats return as the western sky darkens. A white beacon begins to flash across the water.
transfer_check.prompt: Explain what time change is happening and give one clue.

concept_slots.description: State that evening or night is beginning.
Use the dark sky, returning boats, or beacon.

levels.title: Track the evening order
levels.teaching_goal: Arrange sunset, growing darkness, and night-time actions in chronological order.

guided_check.teaching_block: Time order follows the changing sky: the sun lowers, disappears, and then stars become visible.
guided_check.passage: (1) The sun touches the hill. (2) It drops from sight. (3) The first star appears.
guided_check.prompt: What happens after the sun drops from sight?

bridge.teaching_block: Choose what must happen first. A streetlight is usually switched on after the lane grows dark.
bridge.passage: The lane grows dark. Ravi switches on the porch light.

masterclass.teaching_block: Do not use the printed order of mixed words. Use real time. Sunset comes before darkness, and darkness comes before bedtime.

independent_check.passage: Words: stars appear / sky fades / child closes curtains
independent_check.prompt: Order the morning events from earliest to latest.
accepted_answers: sky fades, stars appear, child closes curtains
sky fades stars appear child closes curtains

transfer_check.teaching_block: Sequence a morning change instead of an evening one.
transfer_check.passage: Words: school gate opens / sun rises / children arrive
transfer_check.prompt: Put the sky changes in their evening order.
accepted_answers: sun rises, school gate opens, children arrive
sun rises school gate opens children arrive

levels.title: Hear the hush and see the glow
levels.teaching_goal: Use nearby sound and light clues to understand dim, glow, and hush.

guided_check.teaching_block: Context explains description words. If a room is not fully dark but has little light, it is dim.
guided_check.passage: Only a weak blue light reaches the room, so the corners look dim.

bridge.teaching_block: A glow is a soft steady light. Look for the clue that the light is gentle, not flashing.
bridge.passage: The moon gives a pale, gentle glow above the field.

masterclass.teaching_block: Hush does not mean every sound is gone. It means a quiet stillness. A distant cricket can still be heard.
masterclass.passage: After the doors close, a hush falls over the lane, with only one cricket chirping.

independent_check.passage: Clouds cover the moon, and the courtyard becomes gloomy and hard to see.

transfer_check.teaching_block: Use a sound clue in a library setting.
transfer_check.passage: When the bell stops, a hush spreads through the reading room.
transfer_check.prompt: What does hush mean in this sentence?

levels.title: Build clear night descriptions
levels.teaching_goal: Choose nouns for things, verbs for actions, and adjectives for qualities in night descriptions.

guided_check.teaching_block: In 'The silver moon glows,' moon names a thing, glows shows action, and silver describes the moon.
guided_check.prompt: Which word tells what the stars do?

bridge.teaching_block: First find the thing. Then ask what word tells more about it.
bridge.passage: A silent lane rests below the sky.

masterclass.teaching_block: A common mistake is calling every sky word a naming word. In 'dark clouds drift,' dark describes, clouds name, and drift acts.
masterclass.passage: Dark clouds drift past the moon.
masterclass.prompt: Which pair is adjective then noun?

independent_check.teaching_block: Identify the describing word without options.
independent_check.passage: A cool breeze moves through the balcony.

transfer_check.teaching_block: Create a complete description in a new place.
transfer_check.passage: A train platform is nearly empty after sunset. One yellow lamp shines above a bench.
transfer_check.prompt: Write one complete sentence using an adjective and an action verb.

concept_slots.description: Name a platform, lamp, or bench.
Use a fitting describing word.
Use an action or state verb.

levels.title: Write a small night picture
levels.focus: summarize and describe a changing scene
levels.teaching_goal: Write two connected sentences that show a night setting through specific light, sound, or action clues.

guided_check.teaching_block: A strong description names the setting and adds exact clues. Worked example: 'Night settles over the lane. Window lights glow while the trees grow still.'
guided_check.passage: The riverside is dark except for boat lamps. Water taps softly against the steps.
guided_check.prompt: Which description uses both a light clue and a sound clue?
options: Boat lamps glow while water taps softly at the steps.
accepted_answers: Boat lamps glow while water taps softly at the steps.
boat lamps glow while water taps softly at the steps

bridge.teaching_block: Build one sentence from place + light, then another from sound or action.
bridge.passage: Place: terrace. Light: moonlight. Sound: a distant train.
bridge.prompt: Which sentence uses the light clue clearly?

masterclass.teaching_block: Avoid a list of night objects. A description connects them into a scene and shows what they do.
masterclass.passage: Stars, a lamp, a sleeping dog, and a quiet gate are visible.
masterclass.prompt: Which answer creates a connected scene?
options: Stars shine above the quiet gate while a dog sleeps beside the lamp.
accepted_answers: Stars shine above the quiet gate while a dog sleeps beside the lamp.
stars shine above the quiet gate while a dog sleeps beside the lamp

independent_check.teaching_block: Describe an unseen night setting without a model to copy.
independent_check.passage: The power is off in a village courtyard. Fireflies blink near a tulsi plant, and family members talk in low voices.
independent_check.prompt: Write two connected sentences that create the night scene.

concept_slots.description: Name the courtyard or night setting.
Use the firefly light clue.
Use the quiet voice clue.

transfer_check.teaching_block: Change the context from night to early morning.
transfer_check.passage: A tea stall opens before sunrise. Steam curls above a pot, bicycle bells ring, and the eastern sky becomes pink.
transfer_check.prompt: Write two connected sentences that create the early-morning scene.

concept_slots.description: Name the tea stall or early morning.
Use one action clue.
Use the pink sky or bell sound.

items.passage: A violet sky hangs above closed shops. Lamps glow under the awnings, and people head home.
items.prompt: Which main idea connects the details?
options: Evening is settling over the market.
The market is opening at noon.
accepted_answers: Evening is settling over the market.
evening is settling over the market

items.passage: The last football rolls to a stop. Children leave the field, and a watchman locks the side gate.
items.prompt: Explain what change is happening at the field.

concept_slots.description: Name evening or the end of day.
Mention play ending or children leaving.
Use the locked gate or stopped ball.

items.passage: First the western sky turns orange. Next the sun vanishes. Then porch lights come on.
items.prompt: What happens second?

items.passage: Words: owl calls / forest darkens / sun sets
items.prompt: Put the events in time order.
accepted_answers: sun sets, forest darkens, owl calls
sun sets forest darkens owl calls

items.passage: The faint lamp made only a small circle of light.
items.prompt: What does faint mean here?

items.passage: A tranquil night followed the noisy festival, and everyone rested peacefully.
items.prompt: What does tranquil mean?

items.passage: A soft steady light surrounds the lantern.
items.prompt: Which word names this kind of light?

items.passage: The room becomes quiet as the storyteller raises a finger to her lips.
items.prompt: Write the word for this quiet stillness.

items.passage: The pale moon rises.
items.prompt: Choose the word that describes the moon.

items.passage: Tiny insects hum beside the pond.
items.prompt: Write the verb that tells what the insects do.

items.passage: A lighthouse sends a white beam across dark water.
items.prompt: Which option is a complete descriptive sentence?
options: The white beam sweeps across the water.
accepted_answers: The white beam sweeps across the water.
the white beam sweeps across the water

items.passage: A single candle burns beside an open window.
items.prompt: Write one complete sentence describing the scene.

concept_slots.description: Name the candle or window.
Use a complete action or state.
Add a fitting place or quality.

items.passage: At dusk, cranes return to the wetland, frogs begin to call, and the water reflects the first star.
items.prompt: Which sentence best summarizes the scene?
options: Night begins as wetland animals settle and evening sounds start.
accepted_answers: Night begins as wetland animals settle and evening sounds start.
night begins as wetland animals settle and evening sounds start

items.passage: A hill village grows quiet. Smoke thins above the roofs, dogs curl near doors, and moonlight reaches the path.
items.prompt: Summarize the scene in one or two sentences.

concept_slots.description: Name the hill village or path.
Show that night or evening has arrived.
Use one quieting detail.

items.passage: Curtains close, dinner plates clink, and the lane outside becomes empty.
items.prompt: Which detail best shows the outside scene is changing?

items.passage: Words: moon rises / birds settle / sunlight fades
items.prompt: Arrange the evening events.
accepted_answers: sunlight fades, birds settle, moon rises
sunlight fades birds settle moon rises

items.passage: The stars were scattered across the sky like tiny seeds.
items.prompt: What does scattered mean here?

items.passage: A gentle breeze rustles dry leaves.
items.prompt: Write the noun named after gentle.

items.passage: The balcony is cool, and a radio plays softly inside.
items.prompt: Which sentence joins the two details clearly?
options: The cool balcony is quiet while a radio plays softly inside.
accepted_answers: The cool balcony is quiet while a radio plays softly inside.
the cool balcony is quiet while a radio plays softly inside

items.passage: Before sunrise, milk carts rattle along the road and bakery workers lift warm trays from ovens.
items.prompt: Explain how this scene differs from a quiet night.

concept_slots.description: Name early morning or before sunrise.
Mention work or movement beginning.
Show it is becoming active rather than settling.
